case_order: primary_cases in listed order, then remaining frozen fixture order
boundary: PDP: first target-dependent coefficient descent through independently verified basis, root extraction, original-equation checks and curve replay. Input fixture construction, ring-only plan construction, library loading and result serialization excluded. Algebra controls: frozen coefficient packing through independently certified materialized basis; not complete PDP queries.
cache_policy: Loaded libraries, ring-only descent layouts, declared support masks and allocated input arrays are reused. Fresh target coefficients overwrite every active input slot. Descent zeros are compacted in the original order, and a thread-owned lease spans solving, independent checking, extraction and replay. No answer, basis or numerical elimination is reused. Scratch storage is matrix-local, bounded and contains only freshly computed row values; it is destroyed on return or exception.
resource_envelope: One process, one sequential query at a time, one CPU query thread. No GPU, target batching or cross-target answer cache. Native work/node/row limits, not a hard wall timeout.
primary_acceptance: All three qualified trials on all five primary cases must contain seven verified measured pairs, with the lower paired-bootstrap median-ratio 95% bound above one for baseline/scratch. No routing promotion follows a partial panel.
two_times_target: A target only: report whether every primary lower bound for baseline/scratch reaches two, separately from measured central ratios.
uncertainty: Per-case/trial descriptive paired bootstrap intervals. No familywise or population guarantee. Repeated fixtures do not constitute natural-yield observations.
comparison: Both arms use round 60 leased inputs and the round 58 column matrix. Baseline allocates a fresh vector for each XOR; candidate reuses matrix-local scratch up to 32768 words, falling back above the cap and trimming pivot overcapacity. Proof order and logical work charges are unchanged.
